content: Nsim a un'kyɛɛŋ anà in'kɔk

Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään: isàkal naa mbuur ubilà anki u munàmbwo a làböl a in'kɔk, wɛɛ naa nde kan'lar udu a ibä a làböl, u ntsü yumwɛy, nde wà mbüüb anà un'dwää.
Wɛɛ mbuur afàbilà u munàmbwo, nde wun'kyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk.
Un'leer kun'duub munàmbwo, in'kɔk myàwem ndaa ande. Nde afàbel in'kɔk ande umwɛy umwɛy kà ikɔb awa, waa utwey mya u nsà.
Utaaŋ utwey nde mya myanswà, uyikyà nde kusà a mya, mya myun'lab ungö, ntɔn mya myàkyàyöb ndaa ande.
Ikwe anki akà ikikye naa mya myàsàlab ungyey, mya ikyer asun'tiin, ntɔn mya myàyöb anki ndaa a angyey. »
Yɛsu katɛɛl nsim ayi, wɛɛ ba bàyöb anki naa indiir nà nde kàtɛɛnà.
Yɛsu, un'kyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk aŋàbwaŋ
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa, ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, mɛ in'wà munàmbwo a làböl a in'kɔk.
Baar banswà bàfwel kusà a mɛ bà mbüüb anà adwää, wɛɛ in'kɔk myawem anki.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà munàmbwo. Isàkal naa mbuur kan'bilà u mbwo amɛ, nde asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, nde akyer asàbilà, akyer asàtoo, nde asàman byàdyà.
Mbüüb afàyà nà muyib, mudwa anà mupay. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàyi ntɔn baar bàwɛl mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà bàwɛl wa mbɔɔn.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'kyɛɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ. Un'kyɛɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn in'kɔk ande.

Mbuur afàsal ntɔn ngim mpɛl, nde kà wà un'kyɛɛŋ a ndandaa anki, in'kɔk kà myànde anki. Kya nde usàman kyɛŋbɔl làmuyà, nde la usàkɔɔb nde in'kɔk, waa uwurà ntiin. Apan, kyɛŋbɔl la làsàbürà la mya, waa làsàtà làböl upay.
Le, nde wà un'syääl a ngim, nde undiir ukyɛr anki ntɔn in'kɔk.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'kyɛɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ. Mɛ in'kyàyöb in'kɔk amɛ, mya sye myàkyan'yöb,
Taaràmɛ akyan'yöb, mɛ sye in'kyun'yöb. Mɛ in'fàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ ntɔn in'kɔk amɛ.
Mɛ, mɛ in'we anà in'kɔk myumwɛy mpa amyà uboo a làböl alà. Mya sye mɛ in'kyer atwaal. Mya isàwem ndaa amɛ, làböl làsàkal làmwɛy, un'kyɛɛŋ mwɛy sye.
Taa akyan'kwen, ntɔn mɛ in'fàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ, ungö waa in'fàwal wa.
Akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy afan'duum mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ wa in'fàpà a ukwen amɛ. Mɛ in'we anà ikɔ̈b apà wa, anà ikɔ̈b afàwal wa. Ayi nswɛɛŋ kan'pɛ Taaràmɛ. »
U ndaa ayi, nkaabà yàkyer abilà uboo a amfum a Ayudà.
Bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nde we anà unsɔŋà! Nde wà ŋukɔŋ! Ntɔn nkye lun'weemà bɛ? »
Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: « Mbuur awe anà unsɔŋà ufàtɛn anki abà. Nkye unsɔŋà kan'kwo muduub mii a ikwàmii? »
Yɛsu bàmutɔn
La làkäl paŋà làfakalà mpye mbɔɔn, baar bàkäl mukyɔm mpööŋ a ndwà a Nzam u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Yɛsu kàkäl mulàlyaaŋ u ndwà a Nzam, u myäy bàfàbel naa myäy a Salɔmun.
Apan, Amfum a Ayudà bàkyer un'diŋà, waa bun'fuul naa: « Tii mpal nà asikaar ngye unsà pfürà? Ikyään ubwaŋàbwaŋ isàkal naa ngye awà Klistɔ. »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mɛ ya akyàlakyään itaan, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ lan'si anki làkwikilà. Isal in'fàkyer mɛ kà ikɔb a Taaràmɛ, byàmutà imbäl ntɔn mɛ.
Wɛɛ bɛ lan'si anki làkwikilà, ntɔn bɛ kàlàbà in'kɔk amɛ anki.
In'kɔk amɛ myàfàwem ndaa amɛ. Mɛ in'kyayöb, mya sye myàkyer afan'lab.
Mɛ in'fapà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, mya myàsàkyà anki bwà akà ikikye, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mugyɔɔr mya u kɔɔ amɛ.
Taaràmɛ, mbuur kan'pɛ mya, kan'söön baar banswà. Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mugyɔɔr mya u kɔɔ a Taa.
Taa anà mɛ, bi ibà mwɛy. »
Ayudà bàfàbürà in'kul ntɔn mukun'tà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ kàlamɛɛy isal a ntwɛn mbɔɔn byàfü akà Taa. Isal nà uboo a bya làkwen bɛ mukan'tà in'kul? »
Ayudà bun'fuur naa: « Kà ntɔn isal a ntwɛn anki waa bi katà in'kul, wɛɛ ntɔn mbɛɛy: ngye awà mbuur, wɛɛ ngye, ngye awàmukyey naa ngye awà Nzam! »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Nkye bàsön anki uboo a un'kɔɔn abɛ naa: "Mɛ, mɛ kàtɛn naa bɛ làbà bànzam."?
Bi ikyàyöb naa ikwe anki bàlwom indiir abyà uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn. Kyekà, Nzam kàbel nde baar naa bànzam, ntɔn ndaa ande bàtöm akà ba.
Bɛ, bɛ làtɛn a baal kàsi Nzam an'kɔɔ anà kàtöm nde u mɛɛn naa: "Ngye awàmubɛy!", ntɔn an'tɛn mɛ naa mɛ in'wà Mwan a Nzam!
Isàkal naa mɛ in'fàkyer anki isal a Taaràmɛ, twon làman'sà làkwikilà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ in'fàkyer bya, itàkal naa bɛ lan'sà anki làkwikilà, làsi làkwikilà unsà isal abi. Ntɔn bɛ làyöb anà làkyey naa Taa wà amu mɛ, mɛ in'wà amu Taa. »
Apan, ba bàfàleŋ mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ nde kàkwiyà kà an'kɔɔ aba.
Yɛsu kàfàfurà sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy, kà ikal kàfadümà Ywan utàtwɛb, waa kàbwaay kwo.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyee akà nde, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ywan kàkyer anki akà idiim mwɛy, wɛɛ ndaa yanswà kàtɛn nde ntɔn mbuur awà yàkäl ndandaa. »
Abun, baar mbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà amu nde.
